name: Sinister Creature Con
blurb: Northern California's SFX, makeup and horror convention in Sacramento, with celebrity guests, a cosplay and makeup competition, and a film festival.
notes: The main homepage carries no date text at all. Its own ticket link (lovehorrorevents.ticketspice.com/sinister-creature-con-2026) now reads 'Online Registration is Closed', and third-party listings (Eventbrite, 10times, sacramento365, HorrorCons.com) independently confirm that 2026 run was June 20-21, 2026 at the Scottish Rite Masonic Center, Sacramento — already past, so it is recorded as 'last'. No 2027 (or later 2026) date for the main convention has been announced, matching the batch note. Separately, the site's '/thecon' page (reached via the Tickets link) advertises a smaller 'Sinister Book Fair & Market' side-event with its own dates (Sept 27 and Oct 17, 2026); that is a different, non-guest satellite event under the same Love Horror Events organizer, not the main guest/cosplay convention this file tracks, so its dates were not used here.
